card.name: Because/since introducing a reason for caution
card.fires_on: The reason-giving word (because, since, as, or the 'of' after because) right after a stated contraindication or caution, just before the risk is named.

modes.label: Because / since
modes.description: The conjunction itself opens the reason after a condition or drug group.
modes.example: neuromuscular blocking agents<< since>> cross-reactivity between neuromuscular

modes.label: Of after because
modes.description: The word 'of' completing 'because of' just before the named risk.
modes.example: bladder outflow obstruction because<< of>> the risk of urinary retention

card.writes: It pushes the model toward reason-giving words like 'because' and 'especially' (mostly in Chinese).
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label gives the reason for a warning, such as 'because of the risk of...'.
